name: Shopify
description: An ecommerce platform offering comprehensive REST and GraphQL APIs for managing storefronts, products, orders, and customer data.

evidence.claim: Shopify offers a suite of APIs allowing developers to extend platform features, manage store data, and build custom commerce experiences.
All APIs require authentication and rate limits apply.
Storefront MCP server available for connecting AI assistants to real-time commerce data from Shopify stores.

notes: Shopify provides extremely robust developer tools, official GraphQL and REST Admin/Storefront APIs, official Storefront MCP servers, and a self-serve partner dashboard.
search_queries_used: Shopify authentication OAuth API key developer docs
